recibos.querySql:
WITH base AS (
SELECT
  rec.crecibo AS _crecibo,
  CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(rec.femision, '1900-01-01'), pol.forigen, pol.fdesde) AS datetime) AS fecha_emision,
  CAST(rec.fanulacion AS datetime) AS fecha_anulacion,
  CAST(rec.fdesde AS datetime) AS fecha_desde,
  CAST(rec.fhasta AS datetime) AS fecha_hasta,
  CAST(TRIM(pol.cnpoliza) AS varchar(30)) AS poliza,
  CAST(TRIM(rec.cnrecibo) AS varchar(30)) AS recibo,
  CAST(ISNULL(TRIM(cli_tenedor.xcliente), '') AS varchar(240)) AS cliente,
  CAST(ISNULL(cli_tenedor.cid, '') AS varchar(30)) AS cedula,
  CAST(pol.cramo AS int) AS id_ramo,
  CAST(ISNULL(mcanal.ccanalalt, 0) AS int) AS id_canal,
  CAST(ISNULL(mpro.cproductor, 0) AS int) AS id_productor,
  CAST(ISNULL(pol.ifrecuencia, '') AS varchar(1)) AS id_frecuencia,
  CASE
    WHEN rec.iestadorec = 'N' THEN 1
    WHEN rec.iestadorec = 'P' THEN 2
    WHEN rec.iestadorec = 'C' THEN 3
    WHEN rec.iestadorec = 'A' THEN 4
  END AS id_estatus,
  CAST(ISNULL(rec.mprimabruta, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS monto_recibo,
  CAST(ISNULL(rec.mprimabrutaext, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS monto_recibo_ext,
  CAST(ISNULL(rec.qcuotas, 0) AS int) AS numero_cuota,
  CAST(CASE WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(rec.cmoneda)) = 'USD' THEN '$' ELSE rec.cmoneda END AS varchar(4)) AS moneda,
  CAST(rec.fcobro AS datetime) AS fecha_pago,
  CAST(rec.itiporec AS varchar(20)) AS tipo_recibo,
  COALESCE(rec.fultmod, rec.fcobro, rec.fanulacion, rec.femision, rec.fingreso) AS modified_at
FROM adpoliza pol
JOIN maclient cli_tenedor WITH (NOLOCK) ON cli_tenedor.cci_rif = pol.ctenedor
LEFT JOIN maramos mram WITH (NOLOCK) ON mram.cramo = pol.cramo
JOIN adrecibos rec WITH (NOLOCK) ON pol.cramo = rec.cramo AND pol.cpoliza = rec.cpoliza AND pol.fanopol = rec.fanopol AND pol.fmespol = rec.fmespol
LEFT JOIN macanalalt mcanal WITH (NOLOCK) ON mcanal.ccanalalt = TRY_CAST(RTRIM(pol.ccanalalt) AS SMALLINT)
LEFT JOIN maproduc mpro WITH (NOLOCK) ON mpro.cproductor = pol.cproductor
WHERE (@desde IS NULL OR /*SYNC_DATE_COL*/ >= @desde)
AND (@hasta IS NULL OR /*SYNC_DATE_COL*/ < DATEADD(day, 1, @hasta))
AND (@iestadorec IS NULL OR rec.iestadorec = @iestadorec)
AND (@ramo IS NULL OR pol.cramo = @ramo)
AND (@canal IS NULL OR mcanal.ccanalalt = @canal)
AND (@productor IS NULL OR mpro.cproductor = @productor)
AND (@frecuencia IS NULL OR pol.ifrecuencia = @frecuencia)
AND (@poliza IS NULL OR pol.cnpoliza = @poliza)
AND (@cliente IS NULL OR cli_tenedor.cid LIKE '%' + @cliente + '%' OR cli_tenedor.xcliente LIKE '%' + @cliente + '%')
AND (@moraDias IS NULL OR (rec.iestadorec = 'P' AND DATEDIFF(day, rec.fhasta, GETDATE()) >= @moraDias))
/*SYNC_WHERE*/
),
coberturas_agg AS (
  SELECT
    d.crecibo,
    STRING_AGG(d.xdesc, ' / ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.xdesc) AS coberturas
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CO.crecibo,
      LTRIM(RTRIM(MCO.xdescripcion_l)) AS xdesc
    FROM adpolcob CO WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN macoberturas MCO WITH (NOLOCK)
      ON CO.ccober = MCO.ccobertura
     AND CO.cramo = MCO.cramo
    INNER JOIN base b ON b._crecibo = CO.crecibo
    WHERE MCO.xdescripcion_l IS NOT NULL
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(MCO.xdescripcion_l)) <> ''
  ) d
  GROUP BY d.crecibo
)
SELECT
  b.fecha_emision,
  b.fecha_anulacion,
  b.fecha_desde,
  b.fecha_hasta,
  b.poliza,
  b.recibo,
  b.cliente,
  b.cedula,
  b.id_ramo,
  b.id_canal,
  b.id_productor,
  b.id_frecuencia,
  b.id_estatus,
  b.monto_recibo,
  b.monto_recibo_ext,
  b.numero_cuota,
  b.moneda,
  b.fecha_pago,
  CAST(ISNULL(c.coberturas, '') AS varchar(1000)) AS coberturas,
  b.tipo_recibo,
  b.modified_at
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN coberturas_agg c ON c.crecibo = b._crecibo
/*SYNC_ORDER BY*/
